title: Phase 0B-D: counterexample adjudication, revocation, and transitive support recomputation
description:
ROOT CAUSE: A candidate counterexample is not automatically a refutation, and an adjudicated refutation is useless if descendant authority remains cached. Build the transactional truth-maintenance path.

SCOPE: Admit counterexample candidates only with exact target statement/quantifiers/domain/assumptions, witness identity, numerical/formal authority, provenance, and reproduction requirements. Use a six-way candidate taxonomy: ConfirmedCounterexample, SatisfiableWitness, AssumptionViolation, NumericalArtifact, CheckerArtifact, and ClassificationPending. Universal refutation requires an in-domain satisfiable witness and independent adjudication; existential claims are not refuted by failed search. Adjudication emits immutable evidence, may strengthen or repair a theorem, and never deletes failed conjectures. Confirmed invalidation atomically revokes affected proof/support edges, recomputes transitive downstream authority, tombstones stale runtime receipts, and preserves unaffected evidence. Races, retries, contradictory adjudications, partial graph failure, and later theorem repair have explicit versioned semantics.

ACCEPTANCE AND TESTS: G0 taxonomy/existential-universal laws, exact target binding, idempotent state transitions, minimal affected-set recomputation, and no unrelated demotion. G2 analytic true/false conjectures and numerical artifacts. G3 equivalent witness representation, assumption strengthening/weakening, theorem repair, and support-graph refactoring. G4 concurrent candidate races, cancellation at every adjudicate/revoke/recompute/publish boundary, storage/checker faults, and crash recovery are atomic. G5 deterministic replay. Mutation tests kill domain, satisfiability, independence, revocation, and descendant-recompute guards. A real ledger workflow shows a runtime-admitted descendant becoming unavailable immediately after confirmed refutation. Logs retain target/candidate/witness/assumption IDs, taxonomy transition, reviewer/checker authority, affected edges/receipts, transaction identity, cancellation, and no-claim.

title: Phase 0B-E: portable evidence package, independent checker, and authority recomposition
description:
MISSION: Make every authority claim portable and solver-free to check. A package is not a bag of positive artifacts; it is a bounded, content-addressed proof/support/attack graph whose exact authority can be recomposed independently.

SCOPE: Define canonical package manifests for statements, domains, assumptions, satisfiability/nonvacuity, sources, proofs, numerical certificates, checkers, falsifiers, counterexamples/adjudications, support and attack edges, scale evidence, reproduction, revocations, budgets, capabilities, and logs. Stream and bound parsing, verify every content/semantic identity and source binding, authenticate capabilities/signatures, reject duplicate/ambiguous paths and unsupported versions, and fetch artifacts only through declared capability policies. The independent checker must not rerun the producer or accept producer summaries as facts. Recompose each orthogonal authority axis and downstream runtime eligibility from checked leaves and current invalidation state; disagreement demotes/refuses rather than averaging.

ACCEPTANCE AND TESTS: G0 canonical bytes/root, path and size bounds, graph completeness, signature purpose, exact policy fingerprint, migration, duplicate/unknown field refusal, and authority recomposition laws. G3 package order, chunking, transport, compression, and equivalent graph representation preserve identity/decision. G4 truncation, corruption, zip/path bombs, missing artifacts, malicious capability, checker crash, cancellation, and revocation races never pass or leak. G5 byte/decision stability. Cross-implementation checker and mutation tests target every identity, graph, nonvacuity, admission, invalidation, and runtime gate. Logs retain package/root/schema IDs, fetched artifacts, capabilities, per-node decisions, recomposed axes, invalidations, budget consumption, cancellation, final authority, and remedies.

title: Phase 0B-F: real no-mock red-team, cancellation, revocation, and replay gate
description:
PURPOSE: This is the non-negotiable executable exit gate for Phase 0B. Exercise the production implementations and real persistence/package/checker paths; mocks, handwritten pass reports, and producer-self-verification do not satisfy it.

PIPELINE: Author a true claim, a false universal claim, a vacuous/unsatisfiable candidate, and a conditional claim with unresolved assumptions. Freeze their contracts, canonicalize and admit exact instances, build support/threat graphs, allocate falsification effort anytime-validly, run real falsifiers/checkers, adjudicate all six counterexample outcomes, persist ledger state, package and independently check it, admit only eligible runtime consumers, then inject a later confirmed counterexample and prove transitive revocation plus deterministic replay. Include the per-lane one-bet rule, global portfolio caps, holdouts, correlated evidence, source/policy rotation, historical schema, and no-action decisions.

GAUNTLET: G0 asserts every state transition and authority conjunction. G2 uses analytic fixtures with independently known outcomes. G3 mutates units, quantifiers, assumptions, ordering, representation, graph factoring, and utility/priors. G4 cancels and fault-injects every author/admit/allocate/run/adjudicate/revoke/package/check/publish boundary; tests crash recovery, concurrent races, allocation failure, corrupt storage/artifacts, checker disagreement, and no leaks or partial authority. G5 replays bytes, decisions, graph roots, and logs across thread counts and both reference ISAs. Mutation tests must fail when any admission, nonvacuity, independence, holdout, taxonomy, revocation, checker, reproduction, or runtime gate is removed. Structured logs are bounded and sufficient for future-self diagnosis without consulting plan prose: all semantic/content IDs, units, assumptions, domains, seeds, versions, budgets/consumption, capabilities, graph roots, state transitions, cancellation drain/finalize, checker/adjudicator identities, invalidated descendants, and artifact paths.

title: Theorem Foundry adjudication and support-graph authority
description:
ROOT CAUSE: The existing Foundry infrastructure bead mixes low-risk theorem-card authoring with high-authority candidate adjudication, invalidation, and runtime promotion. That monolith directly blocks a large theorem portfolio and permits implementation order to blur authority.

SCOPE: Consume the Foundry authoring/schema core plus Phase 0B adjudication. Implement the authoritative six-way counterexample-candidate taxonomy: ConfirmedCounterexample, SatisfiableWitness, AssumptionViolation, NumericalArtifact, CheckerArtifact, and ClassificationPending. Preserve separate statement truth, satisfiability/nonvacuity, proof/checker, scale, reproduction, and admission axes. Bind each candidate to exact statement quantifiers, domain, assumptions, witness, TCB, and policy. Universal refutation requires a confirmed in-domain satisfiable witness; failed existential search never refutes an existential. Implement immutable adjudication receipts, support/attack graph recomputation, transitive invalidation, theorem repair/versioning, and exact descendant demotion. Migrate all existing theorem-card main descriptions so the six-way taxonomy and no-claim semantics are authoritative rather than hidden in comments.

ACCEPTANCE AND TESTS: G0 covers every taxonomy transition, existential/universal laws, exact target binding, duplicate/race/idempotency, and invalidation scope. G2 adjudicates true, false, vacuous, assumption-violating, numerically spurious, and checker-corrupt examples. G3 equivalent witnesses/representations and theorem strengthening/repair. G4 concurrent adjudications, cancellation, storage/checker faults, crash recovery, and no partial authority. G5 deterministic replay. Mutation tests kill each domain, satisfiability, independence, TCB, support, and invalidation guard. Logs retain card/statement/candidate/witness/assumption IDs, taxonomy and authority axes, reviewer/checker, affected edges, transaction, cancellation, and remedies.

title: Theorem Foundry production promotion and runtime-consumption gate
description:
MISSION: Provide the sole production/runtime promotion boundary for theorem cards after authoring and adjudication. Research can remain wildly ambitious and begin early; runtime authority remains a checked conjunction.

EXACT GATE: Promotion requires a Stable statement version; SatisfiableWitnessed assumptions/domain; Proved or fully discharged ConditionalProof; exact-instance Admitted receipt; strength-matched nonvacuity; no unresolved authority gap; KernelChecked artifact; ScaleQualified evidence for the declared use; independently Reproduced state; and no active invalidation, revocation, checker disagreement, source drift, or policy mismatch. Each axis remains visible. No aggregate score, positive counterexample search, or summit vote can substitute for a missing conjunct. Promotion binds exact consumer capability, domain, units, versions, budgets, fallback, and kill criterion. Revocation must make all cached runtime receipts unusable atomically while preserving lower-authority research artifacts.

ACCEPTANCE AND TESTS: Table-driven G0 test removes each conjunct individually and observes typed refusal with ranked remedy; exact eligible fixture promotes. G3 equivalent package/statement representation preserves decision while changed assumptions/domain/consumer strength does not. G4 concurrent promotion/revocation, cancellation, stale caches, policy/source rotation, storage/checker faults, and crash recovery never leave a usable partial receipt. G5 deterministic decision and receipt bytes. Mutation tests kill every conjunct. Real no-mock E2E runs authoring through adjudication, package/checker, promotion, runtime consumption, later counterexample revocation, and replay. Logs retain every axis and artifact ID, requested consumer strength/capability, budgets, policy, decision, receipt/tombstone, invalidation, cancellation, and remedies.

title: Validated events on prescribed analytic motor paths
description:
BACKGROUND: Machine simulation is hybrid (Geneva engagement, gear handoff, valve motion, commutation). Doctrine D3: every discrete transition carries a class-valid certificate, a typed Unknown/PossibleEvent, a set-valued grazing/Zeno outcome, an explicit refusal, or an Estimated baseline label — silent event misses are Sev-0. This bead builds the PRESCRIBED-PATH rung: for analytic MotorPaths, interval/Taylor evaluation can enclose the EXACT path directly (no flowpipe needed), so complete root accounting is achievable now with fs-ivl primitives (TaylorModel1, krawczyk_step). The simulated-flow rung (ValidatedStep over true ODE/DAE flows) is a SEPARATE E2 bead — roots of an interpolant are not roots of the true flow.

SCOPE: (1) guard evaluation over CertifiedMotorTube segments: range + derivative enclosures prove exclusion or partition the interval; (2) COMPLETE FINITE ROOT ACCOUNTING claimed only for serialized guard families with an isolability theorem (polynomial/analytic or Taylor-model guards with certified nonflatness/finite derivative order, or a declared definable class on a compact box); interval Newton/Krawczyk certifies existence/uniqueness of simple roots; class-specific root-count/exclusion subdivision proves ALL roots accounted; (3) arbitrary smooth/black-box guards get Unknown, a set-valued inclusion, or refusal — NEVER a fake finite certificate (a zero-containing interval alone does not prove a root); (4) grazing uses joint (g, gdot, ...) enclosures; simultaneous events enumerate admissible orders or return set-valued post-states; (5) artifacts: CertifiedEvent {time, guard, pre_set, post_set}, NoEventCertificate, PossibleEvent, RootCountCertificate, ModeLedger, Zeno budget with typed refusal; (6) the classical dense-output lane stays as a fast Estimated baseline AND independent falsifier.

TESTS (unit + adversarial, detailed logging): analytic fixtures with known root counts (all found, count certified); adversarial grazing families where Unknown IS the correct verdict (a false certificate here is Sev-0); 100x-resolution dense-scan falsifier harness (scans only FALSIFY, never prove); simultaneous-event order enumeration; per-step logs of subdivision counts, certificate class, and guard enclosure widths (PO-4 discipline).

title: fs-feec: WeightedStar/WeightedMass operators plus formulation proof lanes
description:
BACKGROUND: FEEC splits every PDE into exact topology (incidence, dd=0, machine-checkable today) and metric content (Hodge stars). Bulk material properties — heat capacity rho*c, conductivity k, permittivity eps, reluctivity nu, density — are weights on mass/Hodge operators. This is THE highest-EV lever (62.5): one assembler unlocks heat, electrostatics, current flow, magnetics, and Darcy. But the honest version of the claim matters: weighting cannot break dd=0 (the star never touches d), yet dd=0 alone proves NEITHER stability NOR absence of spurious modes.

SCOPE (fs-feec upgrade): (1) WeightedStar/WeightedMass assembling scalar, SPD-tensor, and nonlinear (e.g., nu(|B|^2) per Newton iterate) bulk weights over existing Whitney/Nedelec/RT spaces AND the new TriComplex2; piecewise-constant-per-cell weights first [S], quadrature-point anisotropic/frequency/history-dependent maps behind [F] flags; (2) explicit primal/dual/twisted-form and trace orientation contracts; (3) typed block operators carrying reversible skew and cross-coupling (Hall, gyroscopic, piezo/thermoelectric later) WITHOUT pretending each block is SPD; (4) the formulation proof-lane scaffolding every consumer must fill: subcomplex + bounded commuting projection, boundary/gauge treatment, coercivity or inf-sup, discrete compactness/eigenmode behavior where applicable, material positivity/monotonicity, quadrature consistency, and QoI convergence.

DOCTRINE BOUNDARY (D2): interface laws, reactions, and history-dependent internal variables do NOT enter stars — they are typed constitutive-graph nodes (separate bead). No Hodge-star claim extends beyond the mathematics it proves.

TESTS (unit + G0/G1, detailed logging): dd=0 bitwise for all weight classes on both 2-D and 3-D complexes (PO: incidence independent of material); weighted-mass symmetry/positivity for SPD weights; unit propagation through assembled operators (fs-qty dims on operator entries); MMS convergence-order fit for heat and current-flow scalar solves with slope within 0.2 of theory (house G1 gate); coefficient-jump robustness fixtures. Log per-fixture condition numbers and orders.

REFERENCE PIN (status per Appendix-D discipline): Arnold-Falk-Winther FEEC stability — registry row seeded; each formulation-specific proof must be derived/reproduced, not cited-by-name.

title: ModelCrosswalk, FidelitySheaf, and proof-carrying machine twin
description:
BACKGROUND: A world-class system does not force one fidelity everywhere. Each subsystem implementation (lumped, 1-D, 2-D, ROM, 3-D field, empirical correlation) becomes an OBJECT with typed ports, validity domain, cost/error model, state projection/lifting maps, and falsifiers — so fidelity selection is planning under budgets, not vibes.

SCOPE: (1) ModelCrosswalk: records whether two representations COMMUTE on conserved quantities and QoIs; discrepancy is a measured naturality defect, never hand-waved calibration; (2) FidelitySheaf: assigns locally admissible models over operating-regime/spacetime cells; section selection is a constrained planning problem under accuracy/time/memory budgets; an obstruction (neighboring choices cannot exchange compatible state or close the error budget) triggers refinement, model escalation, or refusal; (3) ProofCarryingMachineTwin runtime artifact: nominal/as-built geometry, material/process posteriors, controller version, sensor history, model graph, receipts, unresolved discrepancies; new measurements update only DOWNSTREAM claims through self-adjusting provenance; OED selects the next coupon/sensor/dyno test by expected decision value (existing surrogate/regime/evidence/plan/assimilate/asbuilt crates supply pieces).

ACTIVATION/KILL (strict, [F/M]): baseline is a FIXED-FIDELITY REPLAY; activation requires lower cost at equal decision error on held-out transients; kill criteria forbid a router that thrashes, launders evidence, or cannot reproduce the fixed-fidelity result. Evidence monotonicity: a router may spend more or less compute but cannot silently STRENGTHEN a claim (feeds the fidelity-descent theorem card).

TESTS (detailed logging): crosswalk commutation fixtures (0-D vs 1-D gas on conserved quantities); an obstruction fixture triggering escalation; router-vs-fixed-fidelity comparison harness with decision-error accounting; evidence-monotonicity mutation tests; thrash detection.

title: FLAGSHIP fs-coldplate-e2e: conjugate cold plate, spec to supplier STEP
description:
BACKGROUND: The earliest commercially meaningful whole-workflow demonstrator — a liquid-cooled inverter cold plate (metal block with internal coolant channels keeping SiC power modules under temperature limits while minimizing pressure drop and mass). Chosen deliberately: laminar channel-scale flow (no turbulence-closure or chaotic-adjoint cliffs — the physics is in the industrialized half), genuinely coupled multiphysics (flow + heat), a real commercial reference point (single-purpose cloud services sell exactly this), and it needs NO contact/multibody/EM — so it can close as soon as its thermal/fluid/adjoint dependencies exist, ahead of the harder machine flagships. It is ALSO the thermal-management story for the motor/genset inverters, so it feeds the drive-stack narrative. Suite/module ID inside fs-flagship-e2e; campaign pattern + fs-wasm companion.

REFERENCE PROBLEM (the pinned deck): envelope 250x180x15 mm; three mapped heat-source footprints (~350 W each); 50/50 glycol-water at 8 L/min, 65 C inlet; minimize junction temperature and pressure drop; keep mass down; min channel width 1.5 mm (brazing rule); no trapped volumes (must drain); export supplier-ready STEP.

WORKFLOW (each stage exercises a named capability): (1) envelope/ports/bosses as an F-rep program with exposed parameters; the coolant channel region is a LEVEL-SET DESIGN FIELD — topology (channel count, branching) is an OUTPUT of optimization, not an hour-one human guess; optionally import an existing plate via ext-cad-step-interchange as the initial condition; (2) CutFEM conjugate discretization directly on the SDF: laminar incompressible NS in the fluid (fs-flux ladder), conduction in the solid (fs-thermal), coupled at the implicit interface; NO meshing stage, no defeaturing; resolution allocated by the goal-oriented (DWR) error estimator toward the two QoIs; (3) BCs attach to GEOMETRIC PREDICATES (port region, module footprints) so they survive topology changes — the automation-breaker test is explicit; (4) adjoint of the objective w.r.t. the ENTIRE design field (one extra solve), Sobolev-smoothed descent, topological derivatives for channel nucleation/merging (fs-topols/fs-xform level-set machinery + fs-adjoint); (5) CONSTRAINTS AS CODE: min channel width via the medial-axis/thickness oracle differentiably (fs-query thickness machinery); drainability/no-trapped-volume as a persistent-homology audit gate — zero enclosed voids via the existing cubical Betti b2 check (fs-topo); brazeability rules as a typed supplier-constraint card; (6) ROBUSTNESS + HONEST ERROR: declared budget up front (e.g., junction temperature to +/-2 K at 95% confidence within a wall-clock budget); coolant viscosity varies with temperature/glycol ratio (matdb cards — the water-glycol coolant is in the seed dataset), so the objective is CVaR over that band; anytime-valid confidence sequences stop sampling the moment candidates are separable; dominated candidates cancelled mid-solve; the error ledger ITEMIZES discretization vs material-property vs sampling contributions — replacing the safety factor with an itemized bill; (7) EXPORT: winning level-set re-fit to B-rep with measured deviation bound, STEP out (ext-cad-step-interchange) — the thing the supplier brazes is the thing that was optimized; (8) LEDGER LIFECYCLE: fork the study when the coolant spec changes; diff the two Pareto fronts geometrically.

DELIVERABLES: Pareto atlas (T_junction, pressure drop, mass) with per-elite evidence colors; constraint receipts (width/drainability/brazeability) per elite; itemized error budget; supplier STEP package with manufacturability receipts; the fork/diff demonstration; a CompetitiveCapabilityLedger deck row (this is a natural named-competitor comparison).

WHAT BREAKS FIRST: level-set/CutFEM conditioning on thin channels -> ghost-penalty + aggregation machinery (exists in fs-cutfem); adjoint accuracy through the conjugate interface -> gradient-verification gates (D8) with FD falsifiers; re-fit deviation eating the optimization gain -> the deviation bound is part of the objective audit, visible not hidden.

E2E TEST SCRIPT (detailed logging): smoke tier (coarse grid, two sources) in CI with pinned metric goldens; the topology-change BC-survival test (a parameter sweep that changes channel topology must never orphan a BC — zero silent candidate deaths, every failed candidate logged with cause); drainability gate rejects a seeded trapped-void design; budget-stop honesty (the run stops when the confidence sequence is tight, logged); full campaign G5 bit-replay; failure drill: out-of-validity coolant card demotes the CVaR claim visibly.

description:

title: fs-machine: machine-element continuum — bearings, seals, clutches, drives
description:

title: fs-ir: versioned L6 machine-graph IR with stable identity and lineage
description:
BACKGROUND: A machine is a declarative graph of subsystems, typed relations, interfaces, clocks, controllers, and accounting policy — and that graph must be DATA with stable identity, because windings, contacts, constraints, and adjoints all attach to named features that survive remeshing and wear. Array indices are not identity.

SCOPE (fs-ir upgrade, E0): (1) stable semantic IDs: BodyId, SurfacePatchId, ContactFeatureId, TerminalId, PortId, StateSlotId; (2) subsystem/model relations, typed terminals/clocks, materials/interfaces bindings; (3) IC/BC, motion/event/reset semantics, tolerance/correlation declarations; (4) sensors/experiments, hazards/faults (HazardId for the E7 safety case), ContextOfUse/QoIs/acceptance, accounting and fidelity/escalation policy; (5) one-way lowering into versioned scenario/domain artifacts preserving canonical identity via explicit crosswalks — fs-ir lowers INTO fs-scenario, never the reverse; (6) LINEAGE MORPHISMS: split/merge/remesh/wear/fracture events emit lineage records; ambiguous lineage returns a TYPED REFUSAL and invalidates dependent caches/contacts/windings/adjoints instead of silently rebinding them. Joints, terminals, controllers, and resets are machine-graph relations — NOT fake boundary-condition kinds.

WHY E0: the E0d vertical slice must run against this IR, and every later domain artifact references these IDs; changing ID semantics after E4 would orphan winding/contact/adjoint attachments program-wide.

TESTS (unit + round-trip, detailed logging): FrankenScript -> machine graph -> scenario/domain artifacts -> package/replay preserves stable IDs and semantic hashes; admission rejects dimension/orientation/causality gaps, algebraic loops without a solve policy, missing source closure, unaccounted state — each rejection logged with the offending element ID and rule; lineage-ambiguity fixtures refuse and enumerate invalidated dependents.

title: fs-matdb: L1 immutable cross-physics materials data layer
description:
BACKGROUND: 'Real material properties' means a NAMED CONDITION with uncertainty, not a marketing-grade label. Every downstream physics claim automatically inherits its weakest LOAD-BEARING material datum through the evidence system — and that only works if material data is typed, immutable, provenance-complete, and queried through receipts. New L1 crate fs-matdb (deps: fs-qty, fs-evidence, fs-blake3 only).

SCHEMA (all immutable): ObservationDataset {specimen/process record, method/instrument, observation artifact ref, covariance/censoring, provenance}; PropertyClaim {key, value (scalar/curve/tensor/distribution/model params), fs_evidence::ValidityDomain over typed axes (T, p, frequency, field, strain/rate, composition, history, named dimensionless groups), uncertainty model, joint-uncertainty correlation refs, interpolation policy, evidence descriptor, observation refs, provenance with license + ContentHash}; ConstitutiveModelCard {LawId, LawVersion, canonical parameter block, StateSchemaVersion, InitialStatePolicy, validity, source hashes}; MaterialCard {MaterialStateId = chemistry+phase+temper/process+revision, schema version, supersedes links, claims map, constitutive models, by-key index, content hash}; InterfaceSystemCard {surface_a, surface_b, intervening medium, lubricant/third body, environment, texture frame (opaque L1 ID), claims, models} — friction/wetting/conductance are SYSTEM+HISTORY properties, never unordered pair constants; wetting is a solid-liquid-gas system.

QUERY DISCIPLINE: every query returns Evidence<PropertySample> + PropertyUsageReceipt {query point, selected claims, selection/fusion policy, correlation slices, evaluator/law version, frame transform receipt, interpolation-or-EXTRAPOLATION decision, source hashes}. Conflicting observations stay separate PropertyClaims — fusion is explicit policy; NO map overwrite invents a canonical value. Only load-bearing receipts enter a claim dependency closure (irrelevant weak data cannot demote; relevant weak data cannot be laundered). A citation alone does not make a value Validated — specimen/process match and uncertainty context required.

OWNERSHIP: owns NO executable closures and NO per-run state (those are L3 fs-material/domain adapters); never imports L2 transforms, L3 state types, or L6 persistence.

title: Offline material/species/kinetics pack compiler (L6/xtask)
description:
BACKGROUND: Source parsing, license admission, unit/basis normalization, covariance preservation, and canonical hashing for material/species/kinetics packs must NOT live in L1 (it would drag parsers and policy into the runtime data layer). title: Curated seed material dataset with citations and process states
description:
BACKGROUND: Flagships must run on real numbers with honest provenance, and may REFUSE when a needed process state or interface system is missing. The seed set covers every flagship in the program.

MATERIALS TO SEED (each: named condition, redistributable/licensed source, uncertainty, validity domains; conflicts preserved as separate claims): structural steels 4140 + AISI 1045; aluminum 6061-T6; gray cast iron AND representative aluminum/wear-resistant-coating systems for explicitly named engine and Wankel configurations (never treated as universal — real Wankel housings are coated aluminum, rotors cast iron); OFHC copper; a pinned bearing steel; a NAMED carburized gear-steel + process; winding enamel, slot liner, impregnation epoxy (insulation stack for motor thermal/dielectric work); a named bearing grease; water-glycol coolant; application-specific gear and bearing oils; electrical steel M-19 (BH curve + Steinmetz coefficients + thickness/anneal/test method PINNED — grade name alone is not identity); NdFeB N42 and ferrite Y30 magnets (supplier/process/temperature state pinned; remanence/coercivity/energy product + temperature-dependent demagnetization/recoil limits); PTFE, PEEK, nitrile (seals); air; iso-octane reference fuel then a VERSIONED multicomponent gasoline surrogate; methane; exhaust-gas mixture; a fully identified redistributable 5W-30 reference formulation (viscosity grade alone is not a material identity).

title: fs-mbd: rigid multibody core with three validated integrator lanes
description:
BACKGROUND: Blocker B2 — no multibody dynamics at all. New L3 crate fs-mbd (deps: fs-kinematics, fs-contact, fs-ga, fs-time, fs-solver, fs-spectral, fs-query, fs-matdb; NO hard edge to fs-solid/fs-machine — flexible substructures arrive later as abstract operators composed one-way from above).

STATE: bodies carry normalized PGA motors (double-cover M ~ -M with deterministic convention) + twists in se(3); 6x6 spatial inertia = fs-query GeometricMoments x fs-matdb uniform density receipt (spatially varying density later via neutral weighted integration — geometry never knows materials). Certified mass/COM/inertia with interval bounds are deliverables in their own right. Constraints: holonomic Phi(M)=0 (joints, gear ratios, cam profiles as driven constraints), Pfaffian A(M)xi=0 nonholonomic (ideal rolling/no-slip — never integrated into fictitious position constraints without a Frobenius proof), unilateral delegated to fs-contact.

THREE LANES (all resumable + deterministic): (1) structure-preserving [F]: Lie-group variational + RATTLE-style discrete null-space/projection, with the honest conditional claim scope from the SE(3) lanes bead; (2) engineering [S]: Lie-group generalized-alpha (Bruls-Cardona-Arnold) on index-3 DAE with GGL/stabilized-index-2 option and controllable dissipation — the industrial workhorse for stiff contact-rich problems; (3) nonholonomic [F]: discrete Lagrange-dAlembert enforcing A(q)xi=0 WITHOUT claiming ordinary Hamilton/RATTLE/canonical symplecticity; ideal reaction zero-work receipt paired with a friction-cone feasibility test; exhausting traction triggers a LEDGERED no-slip -> creep/slip/contact transition, never projection onto an infeasible distribution.

RECEIPT DISCIPLINE (load-bearing distinctions): interval evaluation of ||Phi(q_h)|| is a ConstraintResidualReceipt, NOT a bound on distance to the true constraint manifold — ConstraintStateEnclosure additionally requires a validated nonlinear solve/Krawczyk enclosure or certified regularity + inverse-Jacobian bound. Every projection emits ProjectionReceipt {dq, dxi, constraint_impulse, dE, dp, dL, symmetry_defect, adjoint_defect}; only a work/symmetry-compatible projection retains strong invariant claims — otherwise retry/reject or debit the defect into adjoints. Solvers: Newton-Krylov on the saddle system per implicit step; joint-space fast path for open chains; absolute coordinates + multipliers for loops.

TESTS: see ext-e2-test-battery for the full deck (pendulum elliptic-integral period, manufactured-forced trajectory, torque-free top, slider-crank, IFToMM, rolling disk, Chaplygin sleigh); unit tests here cover lane-level receipts, projection accounting, and inertia assembly vs closed forms, all with per-step structured logs (energy/momentum/constraint series).

ARTIFACT NAMES (canonical, for cross-bead reference): ConstraintResidualReceipt, ConstraintStateEnclosure, ProjectionReceipt {dq, dxi, constraint_impulse, dE, dp, dL, symmetry_defect, adjoint_defect}, RollingConstraintReceipt (ideal reaction zero-work + friction-cone feasibility + transition ledger entries), NonholonomicDistributionReport (from fs-kinematics), and the per-lane balance/defect series consumed by flagships.

STAGING / PR PLAN: PR-1 crate skeleton + body/state types (motor + twist, double-cover convention) + inertia assembly from GeometricMoments x density receipts (independently valuable: certified mass properties); PR-2 engineering lane (Lie-group generalized-alpha, index-3 GGL) + ConstraintResidualReceipt + joint-space fast path; PR-3 variational lane + projection receipts + conditional-claim honesty fixtures; PR-4 nonholonomic lane + rolling receipts + transition ledger; PR-5 ConstraintStateEnclosure (validated Krawczyk lane). Each lane lands with its slice of the E2 battery.
ENTRY POINTS: crates/fs-ga/src/pga.rs:273-457 (Motor, exp/log, renormalize — the state algebra); crates/fs-time/src/lie.rs:24-84 (SO(3) precedent + rigid_body_step), galpha.rs:23-135 (the dense generalized-alpha to generalize); crates/fs-solver/src/op.rs:10-21 (LinearOp for the KKT blocks).

title: fs-mbd: flexible-machine ladder — component modes, rods, substructures
description:
BACKGROUND: Rigid bodies are rung 0 of the funded flexible-machine ladder (a permanent-rigid boundary was explicitly rejected). Shafts, belts, blades, valve trains, and seals need flexibility; gear TE-under-load needs housing/shaft compliance.

SCOPE: (1) rung 1 — Craig-Bampton/component-mode synthesis with certified interface modes and truncation indicators (mode/truncation error becomes a monitored assumption A-001: escalate or refuse when indicators trip); (2) rung 2 — geometrically exact beams/Cosserat rods (fs-solid already ships rod kinematics; this wires them as multibody substructures); (3) rung 3 — ABSTRACT nonlinear substructure force/compliance operators implemented by fs-solid adapters and composed one-way in fs-machine or L6 — fs-mbd does NOT depend back on fs-solid (manifest fixture enforces); (4) substructuring interfaces carry power-reciprocity and mode-error receipts (interface work must close between reduced and resolved representations within declared bounds).

TESTS (unit, detailed logging): CMS reduction vs full FE reference on a fixture shaft (frequency/mode error receipts logged per mode count); truncation-indicator trip fixture escalates; rod substructure energy-reciprocity closure; adjoint gates on smooth reduced parameters per D8; per-interface power-residual series logged.

title: fs-mbd: rotordynamics — Campbell, Floquet, whirl continuation
description:
BACKGROUND: Every rotating flagship (gear, motor, Wankel, genset, pump) has shaft dynamics; ignoring gyroscopics and critical speeds would make torque-speed claims physically hollow. Builds on the flexible ladder + the L1 spectral service.

SCOPE: (1) gyroscopic terms in the rotating multibody formulation (skew blocks declared per the constitutive-operator discipline — reversible, non-dissipative, parity-checked); (2) bearing and seal coefficient models consumed from fs-machine/fs-tribo cards (speed-dependent stiffness/damping); (3) imbalance/misalignment excitation artifacts with declared phase conventions; (4) Campbell diagrams and critical speeds via the fs-spectral service with multiplicity-aware interval bounds; (5) Floquet multipliers for periodic operation; nonlinear whirl/bifurcation continuation (subharmonics, oil whirl precursors) reusing solver continuation; (6) receipts: every stability verdict carries the operator assembly assumptions (speed, bearing card validity, gyroscopic inclusion) so a Campbell crossing claim is auditable.

TESTS (unit, detailed logging): Jeffcott rotor closed forms (critical speed, unbalance response) as G1; gyroscopic stiffening/softening sign checks vs analytic references; Floquet on a parametrically excited fixture vs literature values from the pinned registry; continuation branch-tracking determinism; logs record eigenvalue trajectories vs speed with interval widths.

title: fs-motion: two-sided clearance over time and chamber-volume functions
description:
BACKGROUND: Backlash analysis, cam-follower interference, assembly feasibility, and every contact broad phase need certified clearance of MOVING bodies over a time span. Engine thermodynamics needs chamber volume V(theta) as a certified function of mechanism angle. Existing fs-query::separation gives a static positive-gap lower bound only.

CLEARANCE (two-sided is the point): separation_over(a: SpacetimeChart, b: SpacetimeChart, span) -> ClearanceRange {lower, upper, witness_time, errors}. A lower bound alone can prove a positive gap but does NOT enclose the minimum: branch-and-bound over time supplies the global LOWER bound; a feasible time/configuration WITNESS supplies the UPPER bound; if no admissible witness is available the receipt is explicitly one-sided. Chart-conversion, spatial-discretization, motion-tube, and optimization errors are ALL inflated into the range so the claim applies to abstract regions, not merely a converted mesh.

OVERLAP VS PENETRATION (definitional honesty): min over x of max(phi_A, phi_B) exposes a deepest-common-interior WITNESS/inradius for exact SDFs; it is NOT minimum translation distance nor SE(3) separating displacement. Those live in fs-query upgrades (GJK/EPA convex lane; decomposition/interval global optimization nonconvex; pose-space optimization with declared metric). Contact response uses local signed gaps and normals, never a mislabeled global overlap scalar.

CHAMBER VOLUMES: V(theta) for closed chambers formed between moving charts (Wankel three faces; cylinder above piston) via certified quadrature of the region bounded by named charts. Closed forms are G1 oracles ONLY for declared ideal nominal geometries/seal conventions; finite seals, clearances, port cutouts, deformation, as-built geometry all use certified quadrature/enclosures.

TESTS (unit, detailed logging): two-sided range on analytic fixtures (rotating cam vs follower) with witness verification; one-sided receipt honesty when witness search is disabled; V(theta) vs derived Wankel/slider-crank closed forms within enclosure; error-inflation accounting logged per contribution source.

title: fs-motion: CertifiedMotorTube, SpacetimeChart, and motion binding
description:
BACKGROUND: The deepest architectural gap (blocker B1): fs-ga has complete SE(3) motor algebra (screw exp/log, slerp, renormalization) and fs-scenario has rotating FrameTrees, but NOTHING binds a motor path to a chart — geometry is static per-evaluation. New L2 crate fs-motion (deps: fs-ga, fs-geom, fs-query, fs-ivl — NEVER fs-scenario; higher layers lower into it).

CORE DESIGN (subtle and load-bearing): a trajectory is NOT an unconstrained vector of Taylor polynomials — that would leave SE(3). CertifiedMotorTube stores Taylor models in a LOCAL LIE-ALGEBRA CHART plus a certified retraction (or component models with unit-motor/Study-constraint residual bounds); it fixes the motor double-cover sign deterministically; encloses normalization, composition, inversion, and point/AABB action; performs validated chart transitions BEFORE a logarithm cut; and is falsified against pointwise fs-ga::Motor evaluation. MotorPath is the point-evaluation view of a tube.

A MOVING OBJECT DOES NOT IMPLEMENT THE TIMELESS Chart CONTRACT: SpacetimeChart exposes snapshot(t) -> ChartAtTime and certified eval_over(x,[t0,t1]) -> Interval; immutable snapshots may implement Chart with time and path provenance frozen. Analytic constructors: constant-twist screws and the Wankel rotor POSE (eccentric-center orbit + rotor phasing — the epitrochoid is the derived APEX LOCUS, not the body motion). A builder trait lets higher layers (fs-scenario frame trees, fs-mbd trajectories) lower motions into paths — dependency direction stays downward.

title: fs-motion: swept-volume and envelope implicit enclosure charts
description:
BACKGROUND: Gear conjugate action IS envelope theory (the mating tooth profile is the envelope of the moving tooth in the other gear frame), and the Wankel bore/flank geometry is a family of trochoid/envelope constructions. Nothing in the tree computes swept volumes or envelopes (only minkowski_ball exists).

SWEPT VOLUME (honest formulation): for a sign-correct implicit field, inf over t of phi(M(t)^-1 x) represents the union inside/outside predicate — it is NOT generally a signed-distance function even for exact SDF inputs; distance accuracy must be stated separately by region and may fail at medial sets. SweptChart evaluates certified lower/upper implicit bounds by DETERMINISTIC branch-and-bound over t, returning Enclosure or Unknown, never silently advertising exact distance. Rep Router integration only through conversion edges preserving that enclosure class (swept -> mesh via dual contouring; swept -> voxel).

ENVELOPE (the hard honest part): interior candidates satisfy F(x,t)=0 AND dF/dt(x,t)=0, but tangency regularity, parameter-endpoint contributions, branch selection, visibility, self-intersection, and membership in the actual swept boundary must be PROVED, not assumed. Trace the characteristic set by parameterized slices or validated implicit-manifold continuation; classify rank singularities/endpoints/trimming/visibility BEFORE admitting a branch. envelope(chart, motor_path) -> EnvelopeChart with interval-certified containment (envelope inside enclosure band).

WANKEL DISCIPLINE (three distinct certified objects, never conflated): ideal apex-point epitrochoid; apex-seal CENTER/CONTACT locus for the declared finite seal-tip geometry; actual bore as envelope of the seal-circle family under the declared clearance model. Rotor flank is a SEPARATE conjugate-envelope design problem. The rotor is Reuleaux-LIKE, not an exact constant-width triangle; apex seals SLIDE (they do not roll). Analytic trochoid parameterization must be DERIVED and symbolically checked — no mnemonic formula promoted without derivation.

TESTS (unit + falsifier, detailed logging): derived epitrochoid + involute-rack-conjugate G1 oracles; PO-5 soundness — interval set inclusion + exhaustive subdivision is the PROOF, Monte Carlo/adversarial sampling only FALSIFIES (a sampled point outside a claimed enclosure is Sev-0); envelope branch-classification fixtures incl. tangency degeneracies returning Unknown; logging of subdivision counts and rejection reasons per branch.

title: fs-qty: six-base dimension migration (mole) plus semantic quantity kinds
description:
BACKGROUND: fs-qty encodes Dims as [m,kg,s,K,A] (ampere/kelvin already base dims, so volts/teslas/henries are expressible today). But chemistry, equilibrium constants, molar NASA reference data, stoichiometric rates, electrochemistry, and Faraday coupling CANNOT be dimensionally honest if kg/mol is faked as an ordinary five-base quantity. Decision (normative delta, EV score 62.5 — tied for highest in program): add amount-of-substance NOW as an intentional source break, atomically, before any consumer exists. Candela stays out until photometry is real.

SCOPE: (1) widen Dims [i8;5]->[i8;6] across root AND standalone fs-wasm workspaces; migrate every literal dimension vector and generic arity — especially fs-regime 5xn Buckingham-pi rank/nullspace/named-group algebra, fs-opt, fs-ir, fs-scenario::ir, fs-ledger, fs-package, fs-crosswalk, identity digests, parsers, JSON, tests, goldens. (2) Versioned five- AND six-vector wire decoders: legacy values map to mol=0 under a semantic-crosswalk receipt; old bytes/content hashes stay immutable and record old_hash->new_hash (never overwritten). (3) Unit aliases + parser tokens: V, Wb, H, Ohm, S, F, T — with longest-match disambiguation (T collides with tera prefix; S/H/C need care). (4) SEMANTIC QUANTITY KINDS (dimensional equality is not semantic equality): affine absolute temperature vs temperature difference; angle/revolution and mechanical vs electrical angle with pole-pair phase; angular velocity/rpm; torque vs energy; pressure vs stress; strain/composition bases; mass/molar/concentration bases; instantaneous/peak/RMS/phasor; entropy vs heat capacity; logarithmic acoustic levels with reference. These prevent dimensionally legal 2*pi, pole-pair, sqrt(2), Celsius-offset, and basis errors. (5) SpeciesId, ElementId, elemental matrix A, stoichiometric matrix N, charge vector z as immutable artifacts.

TESTS (unit, with detailed structured logging of every migration decision): G0 proves A*N=0 and z^T*N=0 exactly; parser round-trips for every new token incl. collision cases; wire-decoder goldens for both versions; hash-crosswalk immutability; each quantity-kind confusion case rejected with a typed error naming both kinds.

STAGING / PR PLAN (one bead, four reviewable increments; only increment 1 is atomic-breaking): PR-1 the atomic six-base widening + all literal/generic consumer migration + wire decoders + hash crosswalk (must land as one change — partial migration is the worst state); PR-2 unit aliases + parser tokens with collision disambiguation; PR-3 semantic quantity kinds (additive, non-breaking); PR-4 SpeciesId/ElementId/A/N/z artifacts + AN=0, zN=0 batteries.

title: Theorem Foundry authoring/schema and core checker infrastructure
description:
PURPOSE: Provide the shared governance, schemas, proof-artifact lifecycle, executable checkers, falsifiers, adjudication, and replay infrastructure for genuinely new mathematics. FrankenSim deliberately pursues results stronger than existing simulation systems; rigor here protects ambition from being confused with a finite test campaign or an inapplicable theorem.

THEOREM CARD: Persist immutable statement_id and revision, exact quantifiers, units and sign/frame conventions, AssumptionManifestId, imported lemmas, statement relation and lifecycle, mathematics state, formalization state, falsification campaign state, implementation state, independent review/reproduction state, trusted-computing-base identities, kernel version, derivation/proof hashes, unresolved gaps, formal artifacts, executable checker, counterexample generator/corpus, scale qualification, downstream evidence edges, baseline relation, and claim/no-claim boundary. Keep axes orthogonal: Draft/Stable/Superseded/Withdrawn; Conjectured/ConditionalProof/Proved/Refuted; Unformalized/PartiallyFormalized/KernelChecked; Unchallenged/CampaignRunning/FalsifierSurvived/AdmittedCountermodel; Absent/ConformanceChecked/ScaleQualified; Unreviewed/IndependentAuditPassed/Reproduced. A finite checker or survived falsifier never sets Proved.

ASSUMPTION AND APPLICABILITY MODEL: AssumptionManifestId contains individually versioned predicates, decidability class, witness requirements, units/conventions, and incompatibility edges. AssumptionSetState is Unchecked, SatisfiableWitnessed, InconsistentProved, or Unknown. Each tested theorem instance receives a separate AdmissibilityReceipt with InstanceAdmissibility Admitted, OutOfDomain, Indeterminate, or Malformed, per-assumption results, exact statement/manifest versions, witness bytes/roots, checker/TCB identity, and independent-reproduction state. Logical implication under inconsistent assumptions may remain formally valid, but applicability/promotion is NoClaim. Unknown never coerces to admitted.

NONVACUITY: Every statement declares NonVacuityRequirement Point, OpenFamily, PositiveMeasureFamily, ScaleFamily, or Custom with exact witness obligation. Each witness produces a separate NonVacuityReceipt bound to statement/assumption versions, family description, parameter domain and units, witness roots, checker/TCB, and independent reproduction. A point cannot satisfy an open, positive-measure, or scale-family requirement. A boring established baseline and explicit claim-relation receipt are immutable parts of every card.

COUNTEREXAMPLE ADJUDICATION: Raw candidates are not card-level counterexamples. Each candidate receives CounterexampleAdjudication GenuineCountermodel, OutOfDomain, CheckerDefect, or ProofKernelOrTcbDefect. Only a conclusion failure independently verified Admitted to the exact immutable statement revision is a GenuineCountermodel and sets that mathematics revision to Refuted. OutOfDomain narrows no mathematics. CheckerDefect demotes implementation evidence. ProofKernelOrTcbDefect invalidates the affected formalization and transitive proof dependencies. Invalidation removes or demotes the affected evidence edge and recomputes downstream authority; a downstream claim supported independently is not automatically refuted. Assumption strengthening, weakening, or replacement creates a new statement revision plus a direction-checked relation receipt; the old revision is never silently edited.

INFRASTRUCTURE AND PORTFOLIO: Implement ledger/package schema, independent checker harness, counterexample corpus and shrinker, immutable baselines, claim-relation and TCB-overlap receipts, invalidation/recomputation, reproduction receipts, and portfolio WIP/resource caps. Proof assistants and symbolic systems are isolated research/dev oracles; production consumes versioned artifacts through FrankenSim-native checkers. The 15 canonical theorem-card child beads own their statements; this infrastructure does not duplicate them.

ACCEPTANCE, TESTS, AND LOGGING: Illegal state promotion, forged/stale receipts, contradictory assumptions, point-versus-family mismatch, admission Indeterminate, out-of-domain falsifier, genuine countermodel, checker divergence, compromised kernel/TCB, alternative downstream support, cancellation, and transitive invalidation all have deterministic typed outcomes. G0 covers state/evidence lattice and schema laws; G3 covers equivalent encodings, statement revisions, and independent checker paths; G4 covers cancellation/faults during proof, campaign, adjudication, invalidation, and publication with no partial authority; G5 replays across workers/ISAs. Mutation tests kill every admission, nonvacuity, adjudication, and invalidation guard. A real no-mock E2E packages a statement, assumptions, baseline, proof/checker/falsifier artifacts, candidate adjudications, scale run, independent reproduction, and downstream recomputation. Bounded schema-versioned logs retain all IDs, exact states, receipts, TCB overlap, budgets/consumption, invalidated edges, authority/no-claim, and artifact paths.

AUDIT SNAPSHOT: Current entry-point assertions trace to docs/NEW_DOMAINS_AUDIT_SNAPSHOT_2acc39f13b49724cf94cb6bb88afbb9c2ed3ad0b.json at source commit 2acc39f13b49724cf94cb6bb88afbb9c2ed3ad0b. The snapshot is authoritative only for listed rows; implementation must re-audit unlisted or changed entry points against the execution source.

NORMATIVE SCOPE OVERRIDE (supersedes earlier monolithic/four-outcome wording): This bead owns authoring schemas, bounded card storage, statement/assumption/domain identities, baseline/falsifier/checker interfaces, and a non-authoritative core checker harness only. It does not adjudicate candidate truth, invalidate support graphs, or authorize production consumption. Candidate records use the six-way schema ConfirmedCounterexample, SatisfiableWitness, AssumptionViolation, NumericalArtifact, CheckerArtifact, and ClassificationPending; interpretation and transitions belong to the dedicated adjudication bead. Card authoring may proceed early and remains ambitious, but outputs are research artifacts until the separate promotion gate succeeds. The implementation must migrate all existing card main descriptions to this taxonomy and retain any stronger comment detail in the authoritative description.

Counterexample adjudication must distinguish GenuineCountermodel, OutOfDomain, SpecificationDefect, AdmissionCheckerDefect, ImplementationCheckerDefect, and ProofKernelOrTcbDefect. Only an independently reproduced, instance-Admitted genuine countermodel to the exact immutable revision refutes a universally quantified claim. Existential and other non-universal statements may instead be refuted by an independently kernel-checked proof of negation with its own assumptions, TCB, and applicability receipts; absence of a witness is not refutation. title: fs-thermal: storage/transport lanes, radiation, phase change, loss intake
description:
BACKGROUND: No thermal-domain solver stack exists (blocker B6) — only BC types, an adjoint fixture, and an LBM fixture. Motor derating, engine wall heat, seal flash temperatures, and every LossOwnership credit need a real thermal domain. New L3 crate fs-thermal (deps: fs-feec, fs-solver, fs-matdb, fs-material, fs-motion, fs-query, fs-xform, fs-couple).

FIELD LANE: semidiscrete storage and transport SEPARATE: M_HT(T,z) dT/dt + M_Hz(T,z) dz/dt + D0^T M_k(T,z) D0 T = f + b(T), with surface mass, Neumann/Robin, contact, radiation, and moving-boundary terms oriented and unit-checked; implicit first-order steppers; nonlinear enthalpy derivatives; anisotropic composites; temperature-dependent properties; direct energy-balance receipts (enclosure only where numerical AND data paths support one). title: fs-tribo: dry baseline — friction ladder, Hertz, thermal partition, Archard
description:
BACKGROUND: Normative delta: a DRY-TRIBOLOGY BASELINE is a prerequisite of the E2 Geneva exit. New L3 crate fs-tribo (deps: fs-matdb, fs-material, fs-solver + the fs-couple interface-state protocol; does NOT depend on contact solver internals — fs-contact embeds returned traction/state/tangent receipts into its residuals without reaching into tribology).

SCOPE: (1) friction constitutive ladder: Coulomb -> velocity-dependent -> Stribeck curve [F], queried from an InterfaceSystemCard — friction is a SYSTEM+HISTORY property (both surfaces/coatings/roughness/lay, intervening medium/lubricant, third body, humidity, temperature, pressure, velocity, direction, history), never an unordered material-pair constant; (2) Hertz closed forms (sphere/plane, cylinder/plane) as G1 oracles for contact stress; (3) thermal partition + flash temperature: frictional heat = tangential traction contracted with slip velocity, sign and partition explicit so energy/entropy audits close (feeds fs-thermal via ports); (4) Archard wear V = k F s / H accumulating over the ModeLedger — hardness H enters HERE; ductility enters plastic-contact/damage/fracture criteria ELSEWHERE (both load-bearing without pretending they share one law); wear coefficient cards stay Validated/Estimated per D6; (5) each law owns its state schema; runtime wear/lubricant/temperature/memory state passed per query and checkpointed by the run (matdb owns none of it).

TESTS (unit, detailed logging): Hertz vs closed forms (G1); block-on-incline stick/slip threshold tan(theta)=mu_s exact for the ideal rigid block; InterfaceSystemCard query receipts complete (mutation battery); heat-partition closure on a sliding fixture (friction work = heat share + declared other shares, logged per term); wear accumulation determinism across replays; extrapolation-refusal outside card validity.

title: fs-tribo: lubrication ladder — Reynolds films, mixed, EHL, cavitation
description:
BACKGROUND: Bearings, gear meshes, piston rings, and Wankel apex/side seals live or die by lubrication films. Extends the dry baseline with the film ladder; couples to bearings/gears/seals through the neutral interface-state protocol (fs-contact and fs-machine embed returned traction/state/tangent receipts — no reaching into film internals).

SCOPE: (1) Reynolds equation films with Elrod-Adams mass-conserving cavitation; (2) thermal viscosity coupling (viscosity cards from matdb with temperature/pressure validity); (3) mixed/boundary regimes: asperity contact share vs film share with declared load-sharing model cards; (4) EHL: Hamrock-Dowson film-thickness correlations as regime-bounded Validated/Estimated baselines FIRST (Appendix-D pin: NASA-TP-1342 + later independent optical-film/traction datasets); full EHL (pressure/film/temperature/mass and force balance verified, held-out validation) is the certify-or-escalate successor [F->M]; (5) scuffing/micropitting/pitting model cards for gear/bearing life inputs; (6) flash temperature + heat partition consistent with the dry-baseline conventions so tribo-thermal audits close.

TESTS (unit, detailed logging): 1-D Reynolds slider/journal closed forms (G1); Elrod-Adams mass conservation receipts (cavitation zone mass ledger closes); Stribeck-curve regime transitions continuous and logged; Hamrock-Dowson evaluations refuse outside their dimensionless-group validity (named groups logged); journal-bearing G2 deck from the registry with force/flow/power QoIs.

title: V&V artifact schemas: ContextOfUse through PredictionAssessment
description:
BACKGROUND: Verification is not validation (doctrine D9). A result may be numerically Verified and physically only Estimated. Making that distinction MACHINE-READABLE — not a slogan — requires typed artifacts that every flagship report consumes.

SCOPE — six schemas: (1) ContextOfUse: what decision the model serves, QoIs, acceptance criteria, applicability domain; (2) ValidationPlan: which experiments/datasets validate which QoIs; (3) ExperimentArtifact: instrument calibration, synchronized clocks, repeatability/covariance, data authenticity; (4) CalibrationSplit: calibration vs validation vs BLIND HOLDOUT partitions, enforced mechanically so calibration data can never be reused as validation evidence; (5) SolutionVerificationReceipt: mesh/time/nonlinear/iterative uncertainty for a specific solve; (6) PredictionAssessment: model-form, parameter, numerical, data, aleatory, epistemic components + validation metrics that include experimental AND numerical uncertainty + posterior-predictive checks + applicability/extrapolation decision.

RULES ENCODED: the claim dependency graph is QoI-SPECIFIC; numerical/data/model errors may form a declared bound or probabilistic budget waterfall; categorical evidence colors NEVER become percentages or an averaged confidence score; evidence from a high-fidelity code or second implementation is verification/discrepancy evidence, never physical validation. Observability/identifiability/confounding diagnostics and inverse-crime prevention fields included. ASME V&V / JCGM GUM / NASA-STD-7009 inform the schemas; conformance to a process standard is a SEPARATE receipt from model validation.

TESTS (unit, detailed logging): schema round-trips; a fixture that tries to count calibration data as validation is refused; a fixture converting colors to a numeric score is refused; budget-waterfall arithmetic checks; each refusal logs the violated rule by name.
ASSUMPTIONS-LEDGER SCHEMA (seventh schema owned here; runtime-physics assumptions, distinct from the program risk register): every artifact refines rows of the form AssumptionId | predicate | scope | evidence | runtime monitor | violation effect | owner | expiry/review gate. Leaving any domain DEMOTES OR REFUSES per policy — never silent extrapolation.

EIGHT SEED ROWS: A-001 rigid/reduced body rung adequate for named QoIs (mode/truncation + interface-compliance indicators; escalate flexible rung or refuse; fs-mbd; review E3). A-002 MQS wavelength/displacement-current regime valid (dimensionless regime receipt + frequency monitor; electroquasistatic/full-wave escalation; fs-em; E4-E6). A-003 0-D cylinder spatially mixed, 1-D ducts section-averaged (stratification/knock/wave/secondary-flow indicators; multi-zone or multi-D escalation; fs-gas; E5). A-004 smooth/contact capability and continuum scale adequate (curvature/thickness/roughness/Knudsen/contact-duration receipts; change representation/law or refuse; fs-contact + Rep Router; E2-E6). A-005 symmetry group preserves geometry, state, BCs, excitation (representation residual at every update; expand sectors or full model; domain owner; each solve). A-006 material/process/query inside validity predicate (PropertyUsageReceipt monitor; demote, recalibrate, or extrapolation refusal; fs-matdb consumer; each query). A-007 closure/correlation/turbulence/lubrication regime applies (named dimensionless groups + held-out discrepancy; resolved/high-fidelity escalation; law owner; phase gate). A-008 probability/dependence/population model represents manufacture/use (data lineage, posterior-predictive, drift monitor; decision-risk demotion or robust worst-case lane; fs-uq; E7).

title: Winding topology and flux linkage: filament and distributed realizations
description:
BACKGROUND: Field-circuit coupling through cohomology is one of the program's signature moves — fs-feec already computes harmonic bases and cycle pairings. But the honest version has conditions: the de Rham pairing lambda = N<A,c> is valid only with certified cycle/spanning-surface orientation, relative homology class, boundary conditions, and gauge independence.

SCOPE: (1) WindingTopology + FilamentPairing: closed filament loops via the certified de Rham pairing (lambda = N * integral of B through the spanning surface); (2) DistributedWinding: production stranded windings via a divergence-compatible unit-current winding function J_unit with lambda = integral(A . J_unit dV) + declared end-winding/leakage treatment; (3) BOTH realizations share one neutral WindingTerminal {turns, orientation, resistance_model, leakage_model} protocol (lives in fs-couple per ownership rules) and CROSS-CHECK each other where both apply — the same slot winding represented both ways must agree within discretization/end-effect bounds; (4) massive conductors: formulation-specific cut/source-field/relative-cohomology constraints (topology + BC selected; a period of H constrained only when Ampere law, orientation, excitation model, and generator choice make the pairing valid); (5) v = Ri + dlambda/dt under the declared sign convention closes the loop with fs-circuit; (6) ADJOINT HONESTY: the discrete pairing is linear for a FIXED mesh/winding function so its VJP is exact; geometry motion, nonlinear materials, circuit coupling, end effects, and time differentiation do NOT come for free and are separately recorded; (7) gauge-invariance and energy-reciprocity tests are MERGE GATES.

TESTS (detailed logging): filament-vs-distributed agreement fixture with bounds; gauge-change invariance of lambda; homologous-cut invariance (tree/cotree change leaves flux linkage fixed — feeds the electromechanical theorem card); reciprocity fixtures; per-winding orientation receipts logged.

title: Engineer workflow and FMI/SSP quarantined interoperability
description:
BACKGROUND: Adoption requires the end-to-end engineer workflow to be explicit and the interchange story honest: import/create geometry -> assemble/joint -> bind materials/interfaces/as-built state -> declare IC/BC, drive/load cycle, tolerances, faults, hazards -> choose ContextOfUse/QoIs/acceptance/budgets -> admit fidelity/solver/escalation policy -> calibrate on training data -> verify/validate on holdouts -> simulate/UQ/optimize -> export replay, evidence, decision package.

SCOPE: (1) the workflow above as an executable, documented path over the machine IR (each arrow a checked admission step); (2) canonical interchange stays FrankenSim-native and content-addressed; (3) FMI 3.0.2 / SSP 2.0: pure-Rust PARSING/EXPORT, or quarantined isolated-process adapters — foreign FMU execution stays OUTSIDE the trusted production dependency graph and its outputs CANNOT inherit native certificate status (they enter as Estimated external evidence at best); (4) round-trip batteries: FrankenScript -> machine graph -> scenario/domain artifacts -> package/replay preserving stable IDs and semantic hashes (extends the E0a round trip to the full workflow).

ACCEPTANCE (E7 exit item): FMI/SSP quarantine conformance demonstrated — import an external model description, run it isolated, consume outputs with honest evidence labeling; export a FrankenSim machine as SSP without losing identity.

TESTS (detailed logging): round-trip battery; a quarantine-escape attempt (FMU output claiming Verified) refused; workflow-step admission failures produce actionable diagnostics; determinism of export hashes.
CONVENTIONAL-CAD VOCABULARY MAP (the onboarding/positioning contract for engineers coming from SolidWorks/Fusion/NX; each row is a design requirement on our side, not marketing):
1. Feature tree (sketch->extrude->fillet) MAPS TO F-rep program with exposed parameters — same geometry-as-a-program idea, but differentiable, with no rebuild errors because there are no trimmed-surface intersections to fail.
2. Fillet feature MAPS TO R-function blend — radius is a smooth optimizable parameter.
3. Named faces for loads/BCs MAPS TO geometric predicates on regions — BCs attach to predicates ('the port region', 'within the module footprint') that SURVIVE TOPOLOGY CHANGES; the number-one automation-breaker in conventional loops (parameter change deletes the named face, chain dies at run 37 overnight) disappears by construction. fs-scenario region binding + machine-IR stable IDs already implement this discipline; this row makes it a tested guarantee (a topology-changing parameter sweep must never orphan a BC).
4. Design table/configurations MAPS TO the parameterization theta — table rows become the optimizer domain.
5. Mesh + convergence study MAPS TO CutFEM on implicit geometry + goal-oriented error budget — the meshing stage (and its calendar cost) leaves the loop; the error budget replaces mesh-independence folklore.
6. DOE wrapper (HEEDS/Isight/modeFRONTIER) MAPS TO adjoint-driven optimization + e-raced populations — gradients over design FIELDS instead of a GA over a dozen parameters; doomed candidates cancelled mid-solve.
7. PDM vault/file versions MAPS TO the content-addressed ledger — explain() any number; fork any study; diff Pareto fronts geometrically.
8. STEP export MAPS TO certified/measured B-rep re-fit (see ext-cad-step-interchange) — the optimized geometry ships, not a manual redrawing of it.
9. Safety factor MAPS TO the itemized error ledger — ignorance becomes attributable (discretization vs material-data vs sampling) and reducible.
HONESTY ROWS (what does not improve): physical prototype tests remain; accuracy stays bounded by materials data (the error ledger will report when brazed-joint conductivity dominates discretization error — clarifying and humbling); GD&T/drawings/code compliance live in the conventional world reached through STEP; analyst sign-off culture ('show me the mesh') is earned benchmark-by-benchmark via the Gauntlet, not asserted.

title: EXTREAL program: make the epistemic architecture answer to one externally validated engineering decision
description:
PROGRAM ROOT — the External-Reality Program (EXTREAL), distilled 2026-07-20 from a three-review strategic synthesis (Kimi review + two adversarial critiques, ~85% adopted). This bead tree is self-contained: no need to consult the original review documents.

CENTRAL THESIS: FrankenSim's assurance architecture (typed units, evidence colors, deterministic kernels, ledger, certificates) is now MORE mature than the physical models, external validation corpus, interoperability, and product workflow it is supposed to support. The failure mode this creates is specific: a result can be precisely provenance-tracked, numerically certified, and cancellation-correct while still being PHYSICALLY WRONG from omitted physics, uncertain BCs, bad constitutive/material data, or invalid context of use — "precisely wrong with an excellent pedigree." The remedy is NOT abandoning the epistemic architecture; it is making that architecture answer to ONE externally validated engineering decision, while treating the sibling constellation, data sources, adapters, and certifiers as part of one auditable trust system. Slogan: "the project needs the friction of external reality more than additional internal elegance."

ACCURACY HIERARCHY (the program ladder — we are strong at 1-2, promising at 3, and levels 4-6 must become the product): 1 arithmetic/implementation correctness; 2 solver/discretization error; 3 geometry/parameter/BC uncertainty; 4 model-form discrepancy and omitted physics; 5 experimental validation in actual context of use; 6 decision risk (can remaining uncertainty flip the engineering decision).

MATURITY LEVELS used across this program (record per capability, see governance epic): L1 experimental component; L2 numerically verified component; L3 integrated workflow component; L4 experimentally validated workflow; L5 supported engineering product capability. Local crate test counts do NOT move the product score unless they advance an end-to-end capability.

PHASING (calendar honesty — the reviews' own 90-day plan conflated L3 and L4): (a) first ~30 days: re-score and ratify the vertical wedge with MEASURED inputs, secure datasets, define context of use and acceptance criteria; (b) by ~90 days: a LEVEL-3 thin slice — stable beta CLI + project schema + one real input artifact + deterministic thermal solve + convergence/uncertainty evidence + report + evidence package; (c) 3-9 months: LEVEL-4 — >=3 external experimental datasets, calibrated uncertainty, a preregistered blind case, independent external reproduction. The L4 clock does NOT start until data and a validation partner exist; (d) thereafter L5 (packaging, support policy, migration guarantees, published validation domain).

GOVERNANCE RULE (the admission test for ALL new work): every new workstream must either (1) unblock the selected vertical, (2) reduce a named cross-cutting trust risk, or (3) consume a tightly capped research budget with an explicit falsifier. Crate creation and issue generation are COSTS that must justify themselves through an end-to-end engineering decision.

PRIMARY METRIC: time from raw/dirty CAD to a defensible, evidence-complete engineering decision. Supporting metrics: error vs blind experiments; empirical uncertainty coverage; false-safe-decision rate; % outputs with complete error budgets; CAD import success on a retained supplier corpus; time-to-explain a surprising result; cross-machine reproducibility; surrogate escalation correctness; independent reproduction success. Kernel throughput and crate/test counts remain diagnostics, not north stars.

GROUNDED CODE FACTS this program was scoped against (verified 2026-07-20): fs-ladder::cht() declares correlation-Nu -> RANS -> LES rungs but supplies only a Refine1d 1-D placeholder transfer; NO conduction-FEM thermal solver, NO Nusselt correlation library, NO contact/interface resistance, NO fan-curve model, NO conjugate coupling exist (thermal reality today = fs-lbm Boussinesq thermal LBM + fs-adjoint heat-equation adjoint + fs-couple port schemas + fs-matdb property storage). fs-wedge KernelMaturity=8 rationale overstates the code. No MPFR/Arb-class oracle exists for fs-ivl (dd-only + 2-ISA golden hashes). fs-evidence UncertaintyBreakdown is 3-term (numerical/statistical/model), not the 8-term engineering budget. No EngineeringDecision type, no project schema (.fsim), no product CLI (only the PV fs-vskeleton .fsir runner). fs-report renders Markdown only. fs-matdb JointStatistics are stored but not wired into query receipts. fs-checker/fs-package are FORMAT 8 / protocol 6; fs-govern Phase-0B-B (durable authenticated checker receipts) is unimplemented. Constellation = 7 pinned siblings verified for content identity, not for governance/review.

CHILD EPICS (all parent-child under this root): e01 wedge re-scoring & ratification; e02 claim-integrity burn-down; e03 certified-arithmetic root audit; e04 external V&V corpus; e05 CHT physics kernels; e06 Cooling 0.1 product workflow (L3); e07 Level-4 validation program; e08 error-budget doctrine & DecisionAssessment; e09 certificate-regime doctrine; e10 fidelity graph; e11 CAD admission & interop; e12 design-build-measure-update loop; e13 constellation trust cone; e14 surrogates-as-proposers governance; e15 GPU policy; e16 governance & metrics; e17 scenario semantics.

ANTI-GOALS (explicit, to prevent drift): do not choose the wedge by declaration (measure it); do not treat GPU as automatically next (evidence-driven only); do not let a numerical certificate promote model-form or experimental authority (no-promotion policy, epic e08); do not build a universal god type for decisions (DecisionAssessment is an L6 projection); do not equate "not fully production-ready" with "absent" when writing status docs (epic e16 doc-drift task); a V&V "pyramid" is actually an evidence PORTFOLIO with independent axes — field data is not automatically strongest.

title: E01 Wedge re-scoring and vertical ratification (measured inputs, 3 candidates, kill criteria)
description:
WHY: The commercial wedge (conjugate heat transfer for electronics cooling, fs-wedge rank 1) was selected by STRATEGIC DECLARATION: fs-wedge/src/lib.rs itself says the four scores are "the plan's strategic judgement encoded as data, not empirical measurements", the 5-day cycle-time baseline is a placeholder, and the KernelMaturity=8 rationale claims "conduction FEM + forced-convection CFD with correlation-based Nusselt rungs" which the code does NOT contain (fs-ladder cht() supplies rung names + a Refine1d 1-D placeholder; no thermal FEM, no Nu correlations). Meanwhile actual technical depth is stronger around SDF geometry, CutFEM, elasticity, adjoints, topology optimization. Choosing wrongly costs a year; re-scoring costs days. The review synthesis: re-score the wedge with OBSERVED inputs before committing the product epic.

WHAT (children): (1) measured wedge inputs; (2) three-candidate comparison — full electronics-cooling CHT vs SDF-based structural/topology assurance vs the compromise "thermal design assurance" (conduction + anisotropic boards + contact resistance + radiation + fan curves + calibrated low-fidelity convection, validated RANS later); (3) measured cycle-time baseline protocol replacing the 5-day placeholder; (4) ratification decision record with kill criteria and falsifier; (5) test/audit lane.

SCORING FUNCTION (record in fs-wedge, keep as data): WedgeScore = f(customer pain, kernel readiness MEASURED against the code inventory, validation tractability, data access, CAD burden, time to decision, differentiation, compute cost, regulatory risk).

SEQUENCING NOTE: conduction/contact/radiation/fan/correlation kernels (epic e05 tasks 1-6) are deliberately robust to this decision — they are required by BOTH thermal candidates — so they are not blocked by ratification; only the RANS rung and the product schema freeze are gated on e01.4.

DONE WHEN: a ratified decision record exists in fs-govern + fs-wedge with measured scores, a measured baseline, explicit kill criterion (>=3x cycle-time reduction within the stated quarters), and a named falsifier; downstream epics e04/e05/e06 cite it.

title: Measure wedge-scoring inputs against the actual code inventory (replace declarative scores)
description:
WHY: fs-wedge's four scores (KernelMaturity 8 / IterationPain 9 / QuantifiableRoi 9 / LowRegulatoryFriction 9 for conjugate-heat-transfer) are self-described as "strategic judgement encoded as data, not empirical measurements". The KernelMaturity=8 rationale asserts conduction FEM + forced-convection correlation rungs that DO NOT EXIST in the code (fs-ladder cht() has only rung names + a Refine1d 1-D placeholder transfer; no thermal FEM, no Nu correlations, no contact resistance, no fan model — verified inventory 2026-07-20). WHAT: For each wedge candidate, produce MEASURED inputs: (a) kernel-readiness matrix — for every capability the candidate needs, record exists/partial/absent with file-path evidence (use the 2026-07-20 inventory as the seed; e.g. thermal: conduction FEM ABSENT, correlation library ABSENT, thermal LBM natural-convection PRESENT in fs-lbm/src/thermal.rs, heat adjoint PRESENT in fs-adjoint/src/timedep.rs, matdb coolant/metal claims PRESENT); (b) validation-data access assessment — which published datasets/experiments are actually obtainable with licenses and raw data (feeds e04); (c) CAD-burden assessment — what geometry classes the candidate requires vs what fs-io admits today (faceted STEP closure only); (d) compute-cost envelope per fidelity rung.

TESTS: unit tests assert every scored input carries a non-empty evidence pointer and that absent-capability entries cannot be scored above a threshold; an audit test cross-checks the kernel-readiness matrix against the workspace (e.g. greps/manifest checks that claimed-present crates/modules exist) and logs a per-entry PASS/FAIL table with paths, so future drift between matrix and code is caught loudly.

title: Three-candidate wedge comparison with an explicit scoring function (CHT vs SDF-structural vs thermal-design-assurance)
description:
WHY: Market logic may favor electronics cooling, but current technical depth is stronger around SDF geometry, CutFEM, elasticity, adjoints, and topology optimization. title: Replace the 5-day placeholder cycle-time baseline with a measured baseline protocol
description:
WHY: fs-wedge CHT_BASELINE.baseline_days = 5 is documented as "a scoping placeholder to be replaced with a real measured baseline." The commercial kill criterion (>=3x cycle-time reduction, meets_kill_criterion()) is meaningless until the denominator is real. Shipping a product claim against a fabricated baseline would be exactly the "precisely wrong with excellent pedigree" failure mode applied to our own marketing.

WHAT: Define and execute a measured-baseline protocol for the chosen vertical's incumbent workflow: (a) enumerate the incumbent toolchain steps (CAD cleanup, meshing, solver setup, solve, post-processing, report) for a representative cooling task; (b) measure or credibly source wall-clock + engineer-time for each step (published case studies, practitioner interviews, or an actually executed incumbent-workflow run), with provenance for every number; (c) store as data in fs-wedge with uncertainty bounds (a baseline is an ESTIMATED quantity — give it a range, not false precision); (d) update meets_kill_criterion to consume the measured record and refuse a placeholder.

DONE WHEN: CycleTimeBaseline carries measured values with provenance + uncertainty, the placeholder is unreachable in the decision path, and the kill-criterion evaluation logs which baseline record it used.

TESTS: unit tests that a placeholder-flagged baseline is REFUSED by the kill-criterion evaluation with a typed error; serialization round-trip; an e2e script that recomputes the kill criterion from the stored record and prints the full derivation (baseline breakdown, target, measured value, verdict) for auditability.
